scope: read-only current source and test inspection; experiments explicitly unrun here

capabilities.source_supported_claim: Default server constructs NewMemoryService, whose constructor allocates process-local maps.
capabilities.boundary: DatabaseURL plus migrations/schema check does not persist these maps.
capabilities.unrun_experiment: Create namespace on own loopback server, terminate process, restart and compare list; record database configuration independently.
capabilities.risk_status: source-derived boundary; no runtime outcome asserted

capabilities.source_supported_claim: pgx-backed core stores and transactions exist; guarded task assignment checks expected timestamp and pending state.
capabilities.boundary: No normal server constructor injects this store; Store excludes additional workload interfaces and task SQL omits JobID/Command/VolumeMounts.
capabilities.unrun_experiment: Run store integration tests on isolated resettable PostgreSQL, then design separate durable-service parity/process-restart test.
capabilities.risk_status: source-derived boundary; no runtime outcome asserted

capabilities.source_supported_claim: MemoryService immediately chooses ready, volume-eligible nodes by len(active)%len(eligibleNodes) and stores TaskAssigned.
capabilities.boundary: This path bypasses Plan CPU/memory and placement-label filtering; port helper differs from planner. Do not attribute planner guarantees to ordinary service create.
capabilities.unrun_experiment: Create service requesting impossible resources/labels against ready fixture node; compare direct Plan output.
capabilities.risk_status: source-derived boundary; no runtime outcome asserted

capabilities.source_supported_claim: One-second server scheduler calls RunOnce; pure Plan filters ready nodes, labels, request capacity, volume eligibility and ports, then deterministic scores.
capabilities.boundary: Most ordinary service tasks are already assigned; independent planning snapshots are not a globally serialized capacity/port reservation.
capabilities.unrun_experiment: Run pure fixtures/properties and two-claimer PostgreSQL test separately; distinguish algorithm, one-task claim and global reservations.
capabilities.risk_status: source-derived boundary; no runtime outcome asserted

capabilities.source_supported_claim: Creates pending tasks, handles version/count/delete/restart policy, can wrap write/event mutations in store.WithTx.
capabilities.boundary: Server uses immediate MemoryService reconciliation and never constructs this Reconciler; default LeaderLock is NoopLeaderLock.
capabilities.unrun_experiment: Run fake-store repeated passes; separately inspect server process call graph.
capabilities.risk_status: source-derived boundary; no runtime outcome asserted

capabilities.source_supported_claim: Adapter can set Docker HostConfig.Memory and NanoCPUs from ContainerSpec.Resources.
capabilities.boundary: AgentTask lacks resource member and ensureTask omits Resources from its ContainerSpec literal. Admission/normalization/planning are not active cgroup enforcement.
capabilities.unrun_experiment: Inspect actual Docker HostConfig for ordinary deployment versus direct adapter fixture; no inferred limits.
capabilities.risk_status: source-derived boundary; no runtime outcome asserted

capabilities.source_supported_claim: Shared desired/actual transition checks, terminal-state restrictions and service operation conflicts protect supported mutations.
capabilities.boundary: Guards do not make independent server memories share state or establish remote side-effect fencing.
capabilities.unrun_experiment: Run table-driven lifecycle and concurrent service-operation tests; process topology remains separate.
capabilities.risk_status: source-derived boundary; no runtime outcome asserted

capabilities.source_supported_claim: Startup constructs rollout controller; asynchronous deployment progression waits for target availability and chooses prior successful service spec for rollback.
capabilities.boundary: Memory-preserving controller restart test is not process restart or database recovery; image history is logical desired spec.
capabilities.unrun_experiment: Record same-instance controller restart and separate real process restart as different experiments.
capabilities.risk_status: source-derived boundary; no runtime outcome asserted

capabilities.source_supported_claim: Startup constructs node monitor; MemoryService records node_lost and conservatively replaces stateless workloads; drain waits for replacement availability.
capabilities.boundary: Offline means missing heartbeat, not proof old containers stopped. Stateful-volume tasks stay for manual recovery; no physical fencing.
capabilities.unrun_experiment: Isolate own two-node fake/real workload; stop heartbeat while old endpoint keeps responding and record stale-report handling.
capabilities.risk_status: source-derived boundary; no runtime outcome asserted

capabilities.source_supported_claim: Agent finds managed containers by task/node/version metadata and reuses/adopts them; unassigned managed containers are cleaned.
capabilities.boundary: Adoption metadata is narrower than full spec equivalence; retries lack permanent/transient taxonomy; connectivity retry can hold polling.
capabilities.unrun_experiment: Inject report loss after create with FakeRuntime, then dedicated Docker test; record managed labels and duplicate count.
capabilities.risk_status: source-derived boundary; no runtime outcome asserted

capabilities.source_supported_claim: Local/PostgreSQL electors and RunWithLeadership wrapper implement lease/cancellation seams.
capabilities.boundary: No server loop uses wrapper. Two default servers are independent memories. Session lock return-to-pool cleanup requires real PostgreSQL verification.
capabilities.unrun_experiment: Acquire with session A, cancel parent, attempt with session B and inspect pg_locks; test normal release and failed unlock separately.
capabilities.risk_status: Potential pooled-session advisory-lock cleanup defect is a hypothesis from cancellation→close→pool release; not an observed outage.

capabilities.source_supported_claim: Controller uses MetricsProvider, recommendation/min/max/cooldown and existing ScaleService path; fake provider exists.
capabilities.boundary: Not constructed in server; no production Prometheus provider or enabled runtime autoscaling inferred.
capabilities.unrun_experiment: Run injected-metric clock tests; verify server composition independently.
capabilities.risk_status: source-derived boundary; no runtime outcome asserted

capabilities.source_supported_claim: API supports HS256 JWT roles and namespace roles, namespace-scoped service operations and static-user override.
capabilities.boundary: Empty JWT secret disables user authentication; exp is checked only if positive. Logical namespaces do not provide network/kernel tenant isolation.
capabilities.unrun_experiment: Test missing/expired/optional-exp tokens and cross-namespace API permissions; protect all listeners externally.
capabilities.risk_status: source-derived boundary; no runtime outcome asserted

capabilities.source_supported_claim: Registration/heartbeat issue short-lived credentials, hash stored token material and support revocation.
capabilities.boundary: Bootstrap auth optional with empty token; server-to-agent logs use bootstrap token; native HTTP is not mTLS.
capabilities.unrun_experiment: Run issuance/expiry/revocation and log access tests; do not claim mTLS integration.
capabilities.risk_status: source-derived boundary; no runtime outcome asserted

capabilities.source_supported_claim: Local AES-GCM envelope encrypts stored values; metadata endpoints exclude plaintext; assigned agents receive needed env/pull credentials.
capabilities.boundary: Local key derivation is not KMS rotation. Docker/node admins can read injected env. Default state still vanishes on server restart.
capabilities.unrun_experiment: Run wrong-key/tamper and metadata-vs-agent tests; capture only redacted synthetic credentials.
capabilities.risk_status: source-derived boundary; no runtime outcome asserted

capabilities.source_supported_claim: Service admission uses cluster policy; propagated security context reaches Docker adapter for user/rootfs/capabilities/host options.
capabilities.boundary: Policy acceptance says nothing about resource-limit propagation. Privileged allowances and host mounts require own threat model; no universal non-root image guarantee.
capabilities.unrun_experiment: Test denied/allowed policy fields and inspect HostConfig separately.
capabilities.risk_status: source-derived boundary; no runtime outcome asserted

capabilities.source_supported_claim: Memory mutations account requests/replicas/services/ports/secrets/registry entries under one mutex; PostgreSQL path serializes namespace quota checks.
capabilities.boundary: Accounting is requested allocation rather than measured usage; memory-process atomicity differs from shared-DB transactional path and unused durable server composition.
capabilities.unrun_experiment: Race concurrent memory scales; separately execute DB quota/store transactions with resettable database.
capabilities.risk_status: source-derived boundary; no runtime outcome asserted

capabilities.source_supported_claim: Parser records supplied registry/name/tag/digest; explicit digest reference can be pinned and admission rejects mutable references when policy requires.
capabilities.boundary: ParserResolver performs parsing, not network tag-to-digest resolution. Mutable tag receives no independently fetched digest.
capabilities.unrun_experiment: Compare supplied digest to mutable reference in parser and end-to-end payload; registry-resolution extension requires new tested Resolver.
capabilities.risk_status: source-derived boundary; no runtime outcome asserted

capabilities.source_supported_claim: Startup controller clones via exec.CommandContext, parses sorted manifests, applies sequentially, records revision/ownership and optionally prunes.
capabilities.boundary: Not atomic across manifests; no signed commit enforcement or private credential provider. Lexical path checks are not a proven symlink sandbox.
capabilities.unrun_experiment: Temporary local repo with first valid and second bad manifest, prune and adversarial symlink path fixture.
capabilities.risk_status: Symlink escape is an unresolved filesystem threat-model hypothesis until adversarial fixture executed.

capabilities.source_supported_claim: MemoryService.GitOpsStatus compares live desired specs and can auto-revert while status is read.
capabilities.boundary: Status GET can mutate state; periodic Git sync reapply is a different path. No all-service transaction.
capabilities.unrun_experiment: Manual scale then status under warn/auto-revert and compare mutations/events.
capabilities.risk_status: source-derived boundary; no runtime outcome asserted

capabilities.source_supported_claim: MemoryService creates pending job tasks; scheduler synthesizes service view; agent sends command/exit report; retries use new task IDs.
capabilities.boundary: retryOrFailJobLocked retries immediately, not timed exponential backoff. Additional service env/auth/security envelope is absent on job ListAssignedTasks branch.
capabilities.unrun_experiment: Run success/failure/retry/delete fixtures; record attempts and timestamps; inspect job payload separately.
capabilities.risk_status: source-derived boundary; no runtime outcome asserted

capabilities.source_supported_claim: Startup cron controller uses clock abstraction, five-field parser, timezone, concurrency policy and missed-run limits.
capabilities.boundary: Day-of-month AND day-of-week, bounded 366-day next search; loop returns on pass error and startup only logs stop. Verify namespace traversal before universal claims.
capabilities.unrun_experiment: Inject clock for AND/next-year boundary, Forbid/Replace/Allow and per-namespace traversal.
capabilities.risk_status: source-derived boundary; no runtime outcome asserted

capabilities.source_supported_claim: Volume/claim/attachment records constrain node and single-writer eligibility; agent sends Docker named volume mounts.
capabilities.boundary: Local Docker volume is not replicated storage; safe automated stateful identity/order/recovery remains design only. Memory attachment ownership is not physical fencing.
capabilities.unrun_experiment: Dedicated named volume write/read, incompatible node/second-writer fixture, cleanup only owned volumes.
capabilities.risk_status: source-derived boundary; no runtime outcome asserted

capabilities.source_supported_claim: API derives healthy endpoints and Traefik config; optional ORCH_DNS_ADDR starts UDP DNS in server with configured TTL.
capabilities.boundary: Host-port discovery is not overlay/CNI/network policy, and external reverse proxy remains separate process.
capabilities.unrun_experiment: Run endpoint filters/config fixtures plus own loopback UDP DNS; container routing requires own isolated network lab.
capabilities.risk_status: source-derived boundary; no runtime outcome asserted

capabilities.source_supported_claim: MemoryService dispatcher uses webhook HTTP sender, retries/backoff, optional HMAC and redaction.
capabilities.boundary: No durable queue or encrypted sink persistence established; arbitrary outbound target URLs need separate network threat model.
capabilities.unrun_experiment: httptest signed delivery/retry/redaction plus explicitly scoped prohibited-network cases.
capabilities.risk_status: Outbound-network abuse risk is source-derived hypothesis, not proof all URLs are exploitable.

capabilities.source_supported_claim: Registration/heartbeat check agent ranges; opt-in startup schema guard and explicit migration subcommands use manager locking/version transactions.
capabilities.boundary: Schema check is opt-in; compatibility constants and version warning do not prove rolling upgrades or shared durable runtime.
capabilities.unrun_experiment: Run compatibility fixtures and all 16 migrations up/status/down on isolated DB; test mixed-version binaries separately.
capabilities.risk_status: source-derived boundary; no runtime outcome asserted

capabilities.source_supported_claim: Daily startup loop calls memory pruning; API supports dry run; active/unresolved task history is protected by explicit predicates.
capabilities.boundary: Prunes memory maps/slices, not an integrated durable retention service; requested targets must be checked one by one.
capabilities.unrun_experiment: Fixed-clock dry-run and preservation tests; compare every target, not just aggregate count.
capabilities.risk_status: source-derived boundary; no runtime outcome asserted

capabilities.source_supported_claim: Minute startup snapshots record requested resource/replica/service/task-runtime/port/storage-claim aggregates and report/CSV surfaces.
capabilities.boundary: Requested allocation snapshots are not measured cgroup consumption or financial-grade accounting. Payments/invoicing are future work.
capabilities.unrun_experiment: Fixed-clock known allocation and CSV fixture; never infer currency or actual CPU usage.
capabilities.risk_status: source-derived boundary; no runtime outcome asserted

capabilities.source_supported_claim: Default events/audits remain memory-backed; request/scheduler/rollout/node/agent metrics use injected instruments; optional debug listener serves pprof.
capabilities.boundary: Standalone reconciler metrics are not live if no reconciler loop. Audit append best effort; metrics exempt user JWT; debug listener unauthenticated and configurable.
capabilities.unrun_experiment: Inspect actual /metrics series/auth and default-disabled debug endpoint; prove event atomicity separately with DB transaction.
capabilities.risk_status: source-derived boundary; no runtime outcome asserted

capabilities.capability: Signing, scanning, CNI, plugins, stateful orchestration
capabilities.source_supported_claim: Dedicated design documents describe future signing/trust, SBOM/scans, overlay networking, plugin ABI and stateful identity/order/recovery.
capabilities.boundary: No default implementation/enforcement or production outcome follows from design presence.
capabilities.unrun_experiment: No experiment can validate unimplemented enforcement; use tested teaching extension and new edition lock if implemented.
capabilities.risk_status: source-derived boundary; no runtime outcome asserted
